title: Mentor or Small-Group Touchpoint Cadence
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=retreat:event touchpoint_type=mentor
| stats count as touchpoints, max(_time) as last_touchpoint by group_name
| eval days_since_touchpoint=round((now()-last_touchpoint)/86400,0)
| sort - days_since_touchpoint
description: Tracks how regularly mentoring or small-group touchpoints are happening.
value: Community rhythms matter in many spiritual traditions, and cadence drift is easy to miss without dates.
implementation: Use `touchpoint_type=mentor` on retreat or group events and calculate days since last touchpoint.
visualization: Table of groups by days since last touchpoint.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It maps how long it has been since you checked in with a mentor or small group.
